liturgicalDay.feastOrSaint: Saint Gregory the Great, Pope and Doctor of the Church

verseOfDay.text: And it came to pass, that when the multitudes pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Genesareth,

prayer.title: The Our Father
prayer.note: The prayer the Lord himself taught. Say it slowly enough to mean the fourth line.

consider.question: Does my job matter to God, or only what I do at church?
consider.answer: It matters. Human work shares in the work of the Creator and is one of the ordinary ways a person is sanctified — the Church teaches this directly. Honest craftsmanship, fair dealing, and patience with the people you work beside are not preliminaries to the spiritual life; on most days they are it.
